issues.detail: The Greek 'ζωοποιουν' (zoopoiein) means 'giving life' or 'life-giving'. The Vietnamese translation renders this as 'là sự sống' (is life), which simplifies the active participle into a simple noun/predicate, losing the sense of the Spirit as the source/giver of life.

The Greek 'ουκ ωφελει ουδεν τα ρηματα' contains the word 'ουδεν' (nothing/at all), which emphasizes the total lack of profit. The Vietnamese 'chẳng ích gì' captures the meaning well, but the structure slightly simplifies the emphatic 'no profit at all'.
